description: Shared Renovate policy for all CarlAllenn repos. Policy rationale lives in this repo's README; repo-specific rules stay in each repo's renovate.json.

customManagers.description: Track mise's own version pinned in workflows (mise-action version input)
Generic: '# renovate:' comments above *_VERSION env pins in workflows
Track min_version in mise.toml so the floor keeps pace with the CI-pinned mise

packageRules.description: Non-major updates for semver-stable (>=1.0) packages automerge as silent branch pushes once CI is green; a PR only appears if CI goes red
0.x packages: automerge patches only - SemVer allows 0.x minors to break, so those stay manual PRs
Digest and pin-only updates automerge as silent branch pushes
Runtime dependencies lose human review to automerge, so they wait the docs-recommended 14-day malware-scanner window (security fixes bypass this)
mise-managed tools execute with full env access on dev machines and in CI - the same automerge-without-review rationale as runtime deps, so the same 14-day window (security fixes bypass this)
Group mise-managed tool pins into one PR (rust toolchain rides separately)
Rust toolchain: own PR, never automerged - bumping MSRV is a deliberate decision
Biome rides with the linters group (absent from Renovate's group:linters preset as of 2026-07)
